request:
镜头 s10：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-lab50s）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Super 16', 'Vision3 500T']）：Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：微距，缓慢横移，从一只铁盒移到另一只。两只没有任何连线的铁盒，小灯各自闪着红光，忽然同时变成绿色，同步闪了三下。环境声：两声轻轻的提示音、机房嗡鸣。
情绪：quiet, wondrous, precise
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, slow lateral slide from the near box to the far box
景深与虚实：Shallow focus that racks from the near box to the far box; the bench in between softly blurred.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Insert on the workbench at night: two identical dented tin boxes with antennas sit at opposite ends of the bench, not connected by any cable; each shows one small red LED. Blocking lock: one tin box sits in the foreground at frame left, the second further along the bench at frame right, no cable between them; lamp light from above.
Picture 2: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 3: the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：two soft electronic chimes, low lab hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-insert] 机位：细节特写插入
[ours/trans-match-gesture] 转场：动作匹配剪辑
[rules/size/insert-shot] size
[rules/size/hands-insert] size

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the insert opening frame on the workbench at night from <Picture 1>, serving as composition, lighting and blocking reference. Two identical dented tin boxes with short screw-on antennas stand at opposite ends of a long cluttered engineer's bench, no cable of any kind running between them; each box shows one small indicator LED, both red in this frame. Warm desk-lamp light falls from above and slightly frame right, cold fluorescent fill from overhead, the bench surface scratched and dusty, a scattering of wire offcuts and a notebook edge out of focus. Palette: olive-grey, cold green-cyan, one warm amber pool. No readable text, numbers or labels. Blocking lock: the near tin box in the foreground at frame left, the far tin box further along the bench at frame right, empty bench surface between them, the glass wall and the dark server hall soft in the background, lamp light from above.
<Subject 2> is Song's prototype node, the dented tin box still without a sticker, from <Picture 2>, serving as prop reference. A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, paint chipped at the corners and along the rim, a salvaged circuit board visible at the open edge, a small aluminium heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna tilted slightly; the metal dull, fingerprinted, worn shiny at the lid seam. No sticker, no printed text, no markings on the lid. Surface must read as real practical wear: fine scratches, slight oxidation, dust in the seams.
<Subject 3> is the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) from <Picture 3>, serving as location reference. Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a warm desk lamp; behind a large glass wall a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes overhead, deep shadows in the corners, empty of people.

summary:
A 7-second documentary insert close-up in the 550 project laboratory at night in the 2050s, two unconnected dented tin boxes standing at opposite ends of a cluttered workbench. The camera slides slowly sideways and racks focus from the near box to the far box as both red indicator LEDs turn green and blink three times in perfect sync. Final frame: the far tin box sharp at frame right, its green LED lit, the near box softly blurred in the foreground.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 2> (appears in this shot): fully_preserved — shape, dented lid, antenna, heat sink, LEDs and surface wear retained as the prop; only the LED colour and its blinking change.
<Subject 3> (appears in this shot): fully_preserved — bench layout, materials, fluorescent and desk-lamp lighting retained as the location.

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up insert, handheld camera held close to the bench with one very slow lateral slide from the near tin box at frame left to the far tin box at frame right, ending slightly tighter on the far box while the near box leaves frame; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the near dented tin box in the foreground at frame left with its antenna silhouetted against the warm lamp pool, the far tin box further along the bench at frame right, bare scratched bench surface between them with no cable, the glass wall and dark server cabinets dissolved in the background. Start: the frame sits on the near box, its single small LED a steady red point, the steel lid scratched and dull, the heat sink fins just catching the lamp. Middle: the camera drifts right along the bench and the focus racks from the near box to the far box, its antenna and three tiny LEDs emerging out of the blur, the empty bench sliding past as a soft olive-grey band; both LEDs change from red to green at the same instant and blink three times together, small crisp points of green. End: focus settles sharp on the far box, its green LED lit and steady, the near box now a soft dark shape at the very edge of frame left. Mood: quiet, wondrous, precise. Blur: shallow focus, the bench between the boxes and the server hall behind the glass softly blurred, only the lit LED and the lid edge of the box in focus. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Low continuous hum of the laboratory, faint electrical buzz of fluorescent tubes, the small dry tick of a relay inside the tin box, two soft electronic chimes a beat apart, distant ventilation air, a thin ring of the metal lid settling, no footsteps; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
